summary_en: S.T. Corporation tendered all 339,000 shares of PALTAC held in treasury to Medipal Holdings' tender offer at ¥6,650/share, generating ¥2,254M in proceeds. Tender offer closed 2026-07-14 and was declared successful. Settlement commences 2026-07-14. Gain of ¥1,794M to be recorded as special gain in FY3/27.
title_en: Notice Regarding Tender Offer Response and Recognition of Special Gain
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-09, S.T. Corporation (Estee) disclosed that it had tendered all 339,000 shares of PALTAC (ticker 8283) held in its investment portfolio to a public tender offer launched by Medipal Holdings. The tender offer closed on 2026-07-07 and was declared successful. S.T. Corporation's shares were purchased at ¥6,650 per share, generating total proceeds of ¥2,254 million. Settlement of the transaction will commence on 2026-07-14. As a result of the sale, S.T. Corporation will record a gain on sale of investment securities (投資有価証券売却益) of ¥1,794 million as a special gain in its standalone and consolidated financial statements for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2027. The company noted that its consolidated earnings forecast for FY3/27 is under review and will be updated if material revisions are required.
